## Summary

Describe the focused change and the invariant it preserves or changes.

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] Uses synthetic material only.
- [ ] Contains no phrases, shards, credentials, snapshots, private keys, or
      secret-file hashes.
- [ ] Preserves explicit plaintext output and safe file behavior.
- [ ] Preserves SHEN v1/v2 and SHRD v1/v2 compatibility, or includes a
      separately reviewed compatibility plan.
- [ ] Does not add networking, telemetry, update checks, or vendor APIs.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant focused tests.
- [ ] Normal test suite.
- [ ] Optimized-mode test suite.
- [ ] `git diff --check`.
- [ ] Documentation updated where the public contract changed.

Tests and review are engineering evidence, not a security audit.
